cachingEnabled.description: This is the flag to toggle voice caching for the assistant.

provider.description: This is the voice provider that will be used.

voiceId.description: This is the provider-specific ID that will be used.
voiceId.title: Sesame Voice ID. This should be either a name (a built-in voice) or a UUID (a custom voice).

model.description: This is the model that will be used.

chunkPlan.description: This is the plan for chunking the model output before it is sent to the voice provider.

fallbackPlan.description: This is the plan for voice provider fallbacks in the event that the primary voice provider fails.
